lines.text: David cries out to God from the ends of the earth whenever his heart is faint.
David asks God to lead him to the rock higher than he, for God has been his refuge.
God has been a tower of strength against the enemy, and David asks to dwell in His house forever.
God has heard David's vows, and the prayer asks God to increase the days of the king's life.
The prayer asks God to appoint His loving devotion and wisdom to guard the king, and David will sing praise.
